title: New Video Journalist in Times Opinion
body_markdown:
Sarah Andersen brings sharp creative instincts to producing video for the editorial board. Read more from the executive producer of Opinion shows, Erica Berenstein.


Photo Credit: Georges Kalligeros


We are excited to welcome Sarah Andersen to Opinion as a video journalist producing commentary and enterprise video for the editorial board.


Sarah is an ambitious reporter known for her sharp creative instincts. She joins us from Business Insider, where she was a senior video producer working across several flagship series, including “Risky Business,” “Life Lessons” and “So Expensive.” Her work includes hosted explainers, interview-driven series and ambitious documentaries investigating the human impact of global industries.


Before Business Insider, Sarah field-produced documentaries for Arte, TF1, Al Jazeera and France Télévisions, covering politics, immigration and social issues. She also has worked as a correspondent for France 24. Her reporting has taken her as far north as the Arctic, from Greenland to Alaska. Earlier in her career, she worked at The Financial Times in New York and Le Parisien in Paris.


In 2026, Sarah received the Aïna Roger Award at France’s FIGRA documentary festival for “Breaking the Silence,” a documentary she directed investigating Denmark’s forced contraception campaign against Inuit women in Greenland.


Born and raised between France and Denmark, Sarah is always on the hunt for the best croissant, enjoys the thrill of an art auction and loves traveling to the colder corners of the world.


Sarah holds journalism degrees from New York University and Sciences Po.


Today is her first day.


— Erica
